decisions.reason: Finned tubes for air coolers build directly on the firm's core heat-transfer tube know-how, so it can read market feedback and keep improving the product, unlike the system-level products it already dropped.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes draw on the firm's existing tube-forming and thermal engineering knowledge, which suits its absorptive capacity and its in-house development, so retaining the product is justified despite the missing archived pages for 2020 and 2021.
